programs.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programs.desc:
Behind the scenes of the world of U.S. fighter pilotsNavy.Viewers will learn about preparations for the start of combat missions and exams.Sometimes dreams collide with reality and not everyone manages to survive the technically demanding training.The cameras were installed, among others,in the cockpit of the machines to see for yourself what bombing exercises look like.Candidates face impressive speeds and overloads.Sometimes physical limitations prove to be an insurmountable obstacle.In such conditions, it's easy to make a mistake, you really need to have nerves of steel.One of the key skills is precise landing on an aircraft carrier.Cadets also practice direct combat.To complete this stage, you need to defeat your own mentor and score a "hit" while avoiding the crosshair yourself.On the ground, there will be briefings conducted by demanding instructors.There are many difficult moments when you doubt and lose faith in your own abilities.At the end there is a week of truth.The daredevils then have one last chance to earn the prestigious badge
Members of an elite aviation school must face many challenges during the course.Sometimes the dreams of young pilots collide with reality and not everyone manages to survive the technically demanding training.The cameras were installed, among others,in the cockpit of airplanes to see for yourself what bombing exercises look like.Candidates face impressive speeds and overloads.Sometimes physical limitations prove to be an insurmountable obstacle.In such conditions, it's easy to make a mistake, you really need to have nerves of steel.Initiation stages One of the key skills is precise landing on an aircraft carrier.Cadets also practice direct combat.To complete this stage, you need to defeat your own mentor and score a "hit" while avoiding the crosshair yourself.On the ground, there will be briefings conducted by demanding instructors.There are many difficult moments when you doubt and lose faith in your own abilities.Such situations clearly show how important a strong psyche and coping with stress are for a fighter pilot.A week of truth awaits the young military men at the end.The daredevils then have one last chance to earn the prestigious badge.

programs.title: Witness to Disaster
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the dramatic action in the Chilean gold and copper mine in San José.On August 5, 2010, a rock burst occurred, trapping thirty-three miners at a depth of 625 meters.They spent 69 days underground before they could be brought to the surface.During this time, they stayed in a chamber with an area of ​​only 50 square meters.Only after a dozen or so days was a hole drilled, enabling not only contact, but also the delivery of food, oxygen and medicines.On October 12, all the men were saved thanks to a special escape capsule.
